relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright and tangy flavors of preserved lemon complement the sweet, slow-cooked tomatoes, making it a refreshing side dish.

relations.name: Mojo rojo
relations.rationale: The smoky and spicy notes of mojo rojo enhance the sweet and savory characteristics of the tomato confit.

relations.name: Original Mojo Verde from Tenerife
relations.rationale: The herbal and citrusy flavors of mojo verde pair nicely with the garlicky tomato confit, adding depth.

relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: The umami-rich miso in the ramen can be balanced by the sweetness of the tomato confit, offering a delicious contrast.
